observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: spacious hall with wooden floor and high windows
observation.dancers: mixed group of men and women, approximately 10 dancers total, in couples
observation.formation_and_space: two parallel lines facing each other, divided into couples
observation.posture: upright torso, erect posture, knees slightly flexed during movement
observation.footwork: walking and stepping steps matching the rhythm of the music; exact foot placement details cannot be seen due to long dresses and camera angle
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held near the waist or joined in pairs, holding hands with partners or other dancers during turns and arches
observation.hips_and_torso: torso remains upright and relatively still with minimal hip movement
observation.partnering: coupled dancing with hand holds, leading and following during figures like turning and arching
observation.levels_jumps_turns: upright level maintained, turning movements in circles and passing under joined hands, no jumps or floor work
observation.costume_and_props: men in tailcoats, vests, trousers and gloves; women in period-appropriate long full skirts/dresses with hoop skirts or crinolines and hair up
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details, precise weight distribution, and lower body mechanics are obscured by long floor-length skirts and camera distance

signature_moments.what: first couple walks down the center between the lines and back up
first couple walks down the outside of the lines and back up
first couple circles right with the second lady and half circle left, then second lady passes under
